7/20/24 UPDATE:
"...if all of the ballots had been counted and the same margin held, it could have reversed the outcome of the election..."

- Even the Salt Lake Tribune can connect the dots on this. 
- Never mail in your ballot, especially in Southern Utah. 
- Always vote in person if at all possible.
- Options remain for us to make sure every legal vote gets counted in this race. 
- Stay tuned to see what happens next week!
#utpol
